sql: SELECT 'execucoes' AS item, count(*)::text AS valor, max(d.start_time)::text AS ultima, max(left(d.return_message, 100)) AS msg FROM cron.job_run_details d JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid = d.jobid WHERE j.jobname = 'cleanup-technical-logs' UNION ALL SELECT 'raw_antigos', (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_webhook_raw_events WHERE received_at < now() - interval '14 days')::text, NULL, NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'trace_antigos', (SELECT count(*) FROM message_trace_logs WHERE created_at < now() - interval '14 days')::text, NULL, NULL
